semantics.lifecycle: Without an execution-end receipt, absent results remain pending; process liveness is not probed.
semantics.publicScore: Public levels already scored are retained even if reconciliation or a later level stops.
semantics.reconciliation: Attested by a child level-finished record, matching cumulative acquiredRecords, and a normal final child result; this is not a full executed-ticket audit.
semantics.invalidResults: Duplicates and internally inconsistent results are visible but excluded from aggregate score/action totals.
semantics.unknownTotals: Missing counters remain null; sums contain only known confirmed values and may be lower bounds on errors.
semantics.budgetValidation: Every reported per-level budget is compared exactly with expected-budgets.json, generated by the unchanged pure budget module and both hashed archives.
semantics.fallbackBudgets: 203 levels have no archived individual reference and retain 80 actions / 90000 ms; a stop under this fallback does not by itself identify a solver bug.
semantics.clock: Resolution and post-score reconciliation have separate deadlines; total level ms alone does not establish a deadline violation.
semantics.timingConformance: Only scoredMs is compared with the resolution cap; reported overruns are listed separately, preserve public scores and terminal categories, and require interpretation of rounded measurements/IPC timing. These warnings do not invalidate structurally consistent raw evidence.
semantics.recoveries: Reset, undo and resume counts are reported only when present as nonnegative integers; absent counters remain null.
semantics.scope: One first chronological SIC attempt per game from L1, 100 source games plus SS01-SS07; no historical successes are merged.
